note: The submitted matches come from a cascade: stage-1 LightGBM -> two fine-tuned transformer cross-encoders (features) -> stage-2 LightGBM (final probabilities) -> expected-F0.5 decision. Every component is MIT or Apache-2.0 and far below 8B parameters (largest: 567,755,777).

models.role: final pairwise model: collective stage-2 re-scoring of every pair with stage-1 p >= 1e-3 (stage-1 features + within-S1 context + competition over all S1 + sibling similarities + cross-encoder logits); its calibrated p drives the decision
models.license_evidence: LightGBM library is MIT (github.com/microsoft/LightGBM LICENSE); trees trained by the team on the provided train data only
